test.review_notes: Potential String identity check with ==.

test.message: Loose equality operator `==` performs type coercion and can produce unexpected results (unknown vs number). Use `===` instead.

evidence.reason: Loose equality between `e%10` (unknown) and `1` (number).

test.review_notes: Loose equality (==) comparison subject to type coercion bugs.
